hints.title: Greatest Common Divisor Reduction
hints.text: An integer divides every element in numsDivide if and only if it divides their greatest common divisor.

hints.title: Cumulative Greatest Common Divisor
hints.text: Compute g = gcd(numsDivide) across all elements in numsDivide.

hints.title: Smallest Element Dividing g
hints.text: Sort nums in ascending order. The first element nums[i] that divides g determines that exactly i smaller elements must be deleted.

hints.title: Greatest Common Divisor and Sort Implementation

complexity.notes: GCD across numsDivide followed by sorting nums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking divisibility against all elements in numsDivide individually costs O(n * m).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place sort uses constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that common divisors must divide the GCD of the entire set.
